summary: Warehouse inventory domain foundation adds goods receipt, putaway stock positioning, inventory reservation, pick confirmation, cycle-count reconciliation metadata, and SAP MM/EWM parity-map linkage while explicitly refusing durable persistence, procurement three-way match, accounting ledger mutation, robotics/scanner runtime I/O, carrier calls, shipping-label generation, Workflow execution, cloud deployment, and runtime audit-chain claims.
non_claims: WMS runtime task engine not attached
robotics or scanner runtime I/O not attached

findings: The implementation is a small pure-domain validation/calculation model, not a WMS runtime, robot integration, or ERP monolith clone.
Goods receipt, putaway, reservation, picking, and cycle-count calculations are deterministic guard-clause logic with no hidden side effects.
Flat warehouse microservice destination improves SAP MM/EWM parity without creating microservices/erp.
Capability flags and evidence rows keep cloud/runtime/carrier/scanner claims honest until adapters land.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Tests fail if missing receipts, inactive reservations, capacity shortages, over-reservation, pick quantity mismatches, out-of-tolerance cycle counts, unsafe refs, credential-shaped evidence refs, or invalid quantities/units are accepted.
findings: Positive warehouse inventory flow and negative guard rails are covered.
Types map directly to goods receipt, putaway, stock position, reservation, pick confirmation, and cycle count concepts common to warehouse systems.
Focused warehouse tests/clippy, ERP parity map tests/clippy, 28-package enterprise regression tests/clippy, fmt, data_class scan, and quality-marker scan are recorded in verification.

F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: A flat domain foundation gives ERP MM/EWM parity a service-owned first write path while keeping WMS task engines, scanners, carrier calls, storage, Workflow, and cloud adapters out of scope.
rejected_reasons: Keeping warehouse as a gap left procurement three-way match without an inventory-owned counterpart.
WMS/scanner/carrier runtime requires external devices, credentials, durable state, and operational SLOs beyond this slice.
